scope: Bounded read-only research on label-free hatch matching; no source edits, model downloads, training, or inference runs.

route_evidence: resolver.go:85 initially notes the requested model is absent from local config and defaults to CCPA.
model_config_manager.go:328 propagates backend label Gemini 3.8 Flash (High).

baseline_context.validation: 57 queries / 13 public documents; exposed to prior selection and not an unbiased holdout.
baseline_context.development: 55 queries / 12 documents; use for development pilots, not independent proof.

ranked_recommendations.summary: Compare local descriptor patches against a small query-derived prototype set or empirical distribution instead of only one median descriptor. Test whether it reduces broad matches while preserving faint/sparse recall.
ranked_recommendations.pilot: Start with 10 dev queries split between known false-positive-heavy and faint/sparse cases; record exact reviewed-pixel TP/FP/FN and per-query errors. Then evaluate the full 55-query dev set only if the pilot is promising.
ranked_recommendations.caveat: The proposed k-means prototype counts, 35% FP reduction, and MPS runtime/memory numbers are hypotheses, not measurements. Nearest-of-many prototypes may expand matches; compare with distribution-aware scoring and retain a recall gate.

ranked_recommendations.summary: Audit RGB/chromatic information before adding complexity: the grayscale HGB discards red/blue/cyan distinctions, and the frozen RGB CNN may not use these colors reliably. A query-conditioned color histogram or opponent-color distance could separate hatch inks from similarly textured black/gray drawing clutter.
ranked_recommendations.pilot: On development only, compare query RGB/opponent-color distributions with candidate pixels or tiles; retain color-neutral fallback for grayscale/low-saturation queries. Record coverage and reviewed TP/FP/FN by query, and specifically inspect colored hatches and grayscale scans.
ranked_recommendations.caveat: Root-supplied observation: a q610 example has a rotated bold “HEAD” query, cyan positive bars, and broad false positives elsewhere. This supports investigation, not a claim that color generalizes.

ranked_recommendations.summary: For visibly periodic queries, estimate orientation and pitch from the query, then test multi-cycle autocorrelation in candidate neighborhoods. Bypass when query periodicity is weak; use a boundary-tolerant local test.
ranked_recommendations.pilot: Select 10 dev queries with periodic hatches and line/text false positives; measure reviewed TP/FP/FN with distance-to-boundary strata. Preserve at least baseline development recall before full dev evaluation.
ranked_recommendations.caveat: The proposed FP-reduction targets and runtime estimates are unverified. Text can also be periodic; a fixed pitch test may reject truncated hatch edges.

ranked_recommendations.summary: Test query-conditioned component/region coherence and candidate propagation from reliable seeds, while avoiding any assumption that every hatch is enclosed by a closed CAD boundary.
ranked_recommendations.pilot: On a small dev subset, inspect connected candidate regions, orientation consistency, and leak cases; measure review-domain metrics before expanding. Use explicit fallback for open or broken boundaries.
ranked_recommendations.caveat: The Gemini plan assumes hatches are physically enclosed, which is not established. Avoid gap closing or area rules until their recall effect is measured.

ranked_recommendations.summary: Measure local orientation coherence as an inexpensive auxiliary signal for line hatches; make it conditional on query structure and do not use as a universal veto.
ranked_recommendations.pilot: Compare coherence distributions on known reviewed hatch and false-positive pixels, including crosshatch and non-linear queries.
ranked_recommendations.caveat: The stated sub-250 ms estimate and zero recall-loss claim are unverified.

first_step: Before coding, conduct a label-free feature audit on development query crops and candidate windows: compare median vs. multi-prototype descriptor spread, query color distributions, and query autocorrelation strength. Choose one first intervention from measured separability, then gate it on reviewed-domain recall and false-positive reduction. Do not use exposed public validation to select features or thresholds.

external_models_or_data.verification: No external dependency is proposed, so Gemini’s DINOv2 license assertion was not independently checked.

limits_and_corrections: No experiment in this response demonstrates the aspirational targets (macro IoU >=.95, recall >=.98, precision >=.95).
Validation is exposed; reported scores are not unbiased holdout estimates.
Unknown pixels and supplied query/context rectangles must remain outside negative scoring.

Gemini asserted that only 1–5% of each 34.5 MP drawing is scored and that all remaining false positives count as zero; this was not verified and is omitted as fact. The artifact records known development scoring totals separately in existing sweep reports.
The query median being fundamentally defective, CAD hatch enclosure, claimed runtime/memory, and claimed expected gains are hypotheses requiring repository-specific evidence.
The earlier all-zero pooled query descriptor hypothesis was contradicted by independent checks and is not repeated.
